categories.main_business_segments: Youkeshu Technology primarily operates in cross-border e-commerce export under a B2C model, leveraging platforms like Amazon, AliExpress, and Shopee to sell Chinese-made products overseas. The company also engages in software development, software operation and maintenance services, and sales of hardware terminals and accessories. Its core subsidiaries, Shenzhen Youkeshu and Changsha Youkeshu, are key operational entities in the cross-border e-commerce sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced e-commerce operational management, including inventory management at SKU level, integration of domestic and overseas warehouses, and third-party logistics. It develops intelligent cloud platforms for logistics and energy management, employing technologies such as Linux servers, MariaDB databases, big data computation, and cloud computing. The company also develops intelligent water and electricity meter management systems integrating microelectronics, communication, and network technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Youkeshu serves overseas consumers primarily through international e-commerce platforms, focusing on markets in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Its product categories include electronics, mobile communications, gaming accessories, health and daily products, home furnishings, sports goods, toys, automotive parts, and apparel. The company’s customers are mainly individual consumers purchasing via online retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Changsha and subsidiaries in Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Its cross-border e-commerce business targets international markets globally, with significant sales through platforms like Amazon (global), AliExpress (international), and Shopee (Southeast Asia). It also has subsidiaries and investments in Japan, the US, Australia, Germany, Poland, and the Netherlands, reflecting a broad international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Youkeshu operates primarily in the downstream segment of the supply chain as a cross-border e-commerce retailer and exporter. It sources products from suppliers (upstream) but focuses on sales, logistics, and distribution to end consumers overseas. The company manages inventory and logistics but outsources transportation to third-party logistics providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on strengthening and refining its core cross-border e-commerce business, supported by capital infusion from restructuring investors and industrial partners. R&D efforts concentrate on intelligent logistics scheduling platforms, cloud energy management, and smart utility metering systems. The company aims to enhance operational efficiency, product quality, and customer service to maintain competitiveness amid trade protectionism and platform policy risks.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales on third-party e-commerce platforms (B2C model), including cross-border e-commerce exports and sales of software and hardware products. The company also earns income from software development and operation services. Non-recurring income includes government subsidies, investment income, and debt restructuring gains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Youkeshu is recognized as a leading player in the Chinese cross-border e-commerce export industry, with its core subsidiary Shenzhen Youkeshu acknowledged as an industry backbone enterprise. It competes with major global platforms like Amazon and emerging platforms such as TikTok Shop and Temu. The company holds national high-tech enterprise status and has been listed among China’s top 100 cross-border e-commerce companies for three consecutive years.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Youkeshu reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 387 million, a 16.73% decline from the previous year, but achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 57.6 million, reversing prior losses due to debt restructuring gains. Total assets reached RMB 1.29 billion, up 267.76% year-over-year, reflecting significant capital injection. The company faces challenges from historical debt and operational recovery but shows improved profitability and cash flow trends post-restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Youkeshu emphasizes high cost-performance Chinese manufactured products sold through established international e-commerce platforms, leveraging its decade-long operational experience, strong brand recognition, and channel advantages. Its value proposition includes refined inventory management, integrated domestic and overseas warehousing, and optimized logistics solutions to enhance customer satisfaction and competitiveness. The company also focuses on innovation in intelligent logistics and energy management to support sustainable growth.
